Order 
This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.268/2024 dated 10.06.2024 registered at Police Station Ayodhya Nagar District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 354D of IPC.
2.

entities.text: Police Station Ayodhya Nagar District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Earlier bail applications of the applicant were dismissed on merit vide order dated 05.08.2024 and 21.09.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.31341/2024 and M.Cr.C. No.40283/2024 respectively.
3. Leaned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is in custody since 11.06.2024.
In the meantime, the statement of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1237 2 MCRC-43860-2024 prosecutrix has been recorded.

The prosecutrix in her testimony has stated in unequivocal terms the factum regarding relationship with the present applicant and on her own volition she visited various places with the present applicant and the photographs to that effect have been brought on record as Annexure-A/5.

The photographs have not been disputed by the prosecution, therefore, considering the totality of circumstances and the fact that there is prolong period of custody of the present applicant, he be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and submitted that the applicant is guilty of committing offence of rape against the prosecutrix.
The prosecutrix has supported the allegations recorded before the trial Court, therefore, no case for grant of bail is made out.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.
A perusal of case diary prima facie reflects that the applicant and prosecutrix were in relationship and the prosecutrix on her own volition went with the present applicant.
The applicant is in custody since 11.06.2024 and the charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed.
6. Thus, taking into considering the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1237 3 MCRC-43860-2024 expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480 (3) of the BNSS.
9. Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
